body: apps/desktop now has full theme-popover parity with chrome-ext (renderer/src/ThemePopover.tsx): theme mode dropdown (light/dark/sepia), font-family segmented (sans/serif/mono), size/line-height/width sliders w/ per-slider reset + 'Reset to defaults'. Built with native HTML (select/range) + Tailwind tokens — no basecn dependency. Wired into App header via Type 'Aa' icon trigger. Critical companion fix: App's content wrapper changed from max-w-3xl clamp to style.maxWidth=calc(var(--fv-content-width)+4rem) so the Width slider actually affects rendered prose (the @filemark/mdx body styles already read --fv-content-width). Verified visually via offscreen capture: popover renders correctly with all controls + reset state.
